# Advanced Alchemy

> A carefully crafted, thoroughly tested, optimized companion library for SQLAlchemy.

Full documentation corpus: https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/llms-full.txt

## Overview & Getting Started

- [Advanced Alchemy](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/): A carefully crafted, thoroughly tested, optimized companion library for SQLAlchemy.
- [Getting Started](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/getting-started.html): A carefully crafted, thoroughly tested, optimized companion library for SQLAlchemy 2.0+:
- [Usage Guide](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/index.html): Advanced Alchemy separates database access into three layers so route handlers remain concise and testable:

## Usage Guides

- [Data Modeling](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/modeling/index.html): Advanced Alchemy provides declarative base classes, column mixins, and dialect-portable column types for primary keys, audit timestamps, encrypted fields, password hashes, and object storage.
- [Modeling Basics](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/modeling/basics.html): Declarative base classes configure primary keys, sentinel columns, and optional created_at and updated_at audit timestamps across your SQLAlchemy models.
- [Inheritance Patterns](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/modeling/inheritance.html): Advanced Alchemy’s declarative base classes and repositories support all three SQLAlchemy inheritance strategies:
- [SQLModel Integration](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/modeling/sqlmodel.html): SQLModel classes configured with table=True work directly with Advanced Alchemy repositories and services.
- [Portable Column Types](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/modeling/types.html): Advanced Alchemy provides custom SQLAlchemy TypeDecorator implementations that compile to dialect-appropriate SQL types across SQLite, PostgreSQL, CockroachDB, MySQL, MariaDB, Oracle, DuckDB, SQL Server, and Spanner w...
- [Security and File Storage Types](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/modeling/security_and_storage_types.html): Advanced Alchemy includes column types for symmetric field encryption, password hashing, TOTP seeds, one-time verification codes, and transaction-synchronized object storage.
- [Repositories](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/repositories/index.html): A Repository binds to a single SQLAlchemy model and provides typed synchronous or asynchronous methods (add, get, get_many, get_many_and_count, upsert_many, delete) for CRUD, filtering, pagination, and dialect-transla...
- [Repository Basics](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/repositories/basics.html): A Repository encapsulates SQLAlchemy queries and persistence logic for one mapped model behind a uniform interface (add, get, get_many, update, delete), keeping query logic reusable and testable against SQL or in-memo...
- [Filtering and Pagination](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/repositories/filtering.html): Repository query methods accept both SQLAlchemy column expressions and reusable StatementFilter objects without manual conditional .where() and .limit() chaining.
- [Declarative Filters](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/repositories/filtersets.html): Use FilterSet to group allowed query fields, sorting and relationship loading for one mapped model.
- [Cursor Pagination](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/repositories/cursor_pagination.html): Cursor (keyset) pagination fetches the rows after the last row a client saw instead of skipping rows with OFFSET. Every page costs the same as the first, and rows inserted earlier in the ordering never shift later pag...
- [Advanced Repository](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/repositories/advanced.html): Repositories support composite primary keys, row-level SELECT ... FOR UPDATE locking, conditional bulk deletes, and cross-dialect exception translation.
- [Services](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/services.html): A Repository operates directly on SQLAlchemy model instances (BlogPost), whereas a Service operates on typed input and output schemas (BlogPostCreate, BlogPostResponse). Use a repository directly for table persistence...
- [Service Composition](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/service_composition.html): ServiceGroup coordinates multiple services on one shared SQLAlchemy session so multi-model workflows commit or roll back as a single unit of work.
- [Read/Write Routing](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/routing.html): Read/write routing directs mutating statements to a Primary Database and distributes SELECT queries across one or more Read Replica pools without changing repository or service calls:
- [Caching](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/caching.html): Advanced Alchemy integrates with dogpile.cache to cache repository lookups in memory, Redis, or Memcached and automatically invalidate affected cache entries after transactions commit.
- [OpenTelemetry](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/opentelemetry.html): Advanced Alchemy looks up SQLAlchemy’s create_engine and create_async_engine each time it creates an engine. OpenTelemetry’s SQLAlchemy instrumentation therefore traces the engines Advanced Alchemy creates with its de...
- [CLI & Migrations](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/cli.html): Advanced Alchemy provides the alchemy CLI (along with litestar database and flask database in framework integrations) for generating and applying Alembic migrations, checking schema drift, and exporting or loading fix...
- [CLI Command Workflows](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/cli_commands.html): Once your config is connected, day-to-day schema changes follow the same commands whether you run alchemy ..., litestar database ..., or flask database ....
- [Database Seeding](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/database_seeding.html): Advanced Alchemy provides synchronous and asynchronous utilities for loading, streaming, and writing JSON, JSON Lines, and CSV seed fixtures: open_fixture_sync and open_fixture_async load complete fixtures, iter_fixtu...
- [Framework Integrations](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/frameworks/index.html): Advanced Alchemy provides first-party web framework integrations that manage engine startup and disposal, configure per-request session lifecycles, and re-export core models, repositories, services, and filters.
- [Litestar Integration](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/frameworks/litestar.html): Advanced Alchemy is the official SQLAlchemy integration for Litestar. SQLAlchemyPlugin configures engine lifecycles, per-request sessions, DTO and msgspec serialization, repository exception handlers, and litestar dat...
- [Litestar Services, Filters and DTOs](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/frameworks/litestar_dtos.html): Advanced Alchemy provides two Litestar helpers for controller dependency injection and schema generation:
- [Litestar Database and Server Sessions](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/frameworks/litestar_sessions.html): This guide covers two distinct session layers in Litestar:
- [Litestar File and Object Storage](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/frameworks/litestar_storage.html): StoredObject and FileObject coordinate object storage writes with SQLAlchemy session lifecycle events, writing pending files when transactions commit and deleting superseded or removed files automatically.
- [FastAPI Integration](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/frameworks/fastapi.html): Advanced Alchemy integrates with FastAPI through the AdvancedAlchemy extension, managing engine startup and disposal via ASGI lifespan hooks and providing Depends(...) callables for sessions, services, and OpenAPI que...
- [FastAPI Services and Filter Depends](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/frameworks/fastapi_dependencies.html): The AdvancedAlchemy extension builds FastAPI Depends(...) providers for SQLAlchemy sessions, services, and OpenAPI-documented pagination, search, sort, and date-range query filters.
- [FastAPI File Storage and Multi-Binds](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/frameworks/fastapi_storage.html): This guide shows how to attach uploaded files to SQLAlchemy models in FastAPI and how to connect a single FastAPI app to more than one database.
- [Starlette Integration](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/frameworks/starlette.html): AdvancedAlchemy manages engine startup and shutdown for Starlette ASGI applications and provides lazy per-request SQLAlchemy sessions on request.state.
- [Flask Integration](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/frameworks/flask.html): Advanced Alchemy integrates with synchronous WSGI Flask applications and async def Flask routes, providing app-context SQLAlchemy sessions on flask.g, a jsonify() service response helper, and flask database CLI commands.
- [Sanic Integration](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/frameworks/sanic.html): Advanced Alchemy integrates with Sanic and sanic-ext, managing engine lifecycles on app.ctx, attaching per-request sessions on request.ctx, and injecting AsyncSession or Session into route handlers.

## API Reference

- [API Reference](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/index.html): Complete class, function, and module reference for Advanced Alchemy. Browse any module in the left sidebar or select a section below.
- [FilterSet](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/filterset.html): Reusable filter definitions combine typed field parameters, relationship predicates, sorting, and inferred eager loading. See Declarative Filters for examples and matching semantics.
- [Declarative Base](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/base.html): Documentation for Declarative Base.
- [Mixins](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/mixins/index.html): Mixins that provide common columns and behavior for SQLAlchemy models.
- [Unique Key](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/mixins/unique.html): Documentation for Unique Key.
- [NanoID](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/mixins/nanoid.html): Documentation for NanoID.
- [UUID](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/mixins/uuid.html): Documentation for UUID.
- [Sentinel](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/mixins/sentinel.html): Documentation for Sentinel.
- [BigInt](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/mixins/bigint.html): Documentation for BigInt.
- [Audit](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/mixins/audit.html): Documentation for Audit.
- [Slug](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/mixins/slug.html): Documentation for Slug.
- [Configuration](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/config/index.html): Asynchronous and synchronous SQLAlchemy engine, session, and replica routing configuration classes.
- [Asyncio](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/config/asyncio.html): Documentation for Asyncio.
- [Common](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/config/common.html): Documentation for Common.
- [Engine](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/config/engine.html): Documentation for Engine.
- [Routing](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/config/routing.html): Configuration classes for read/write replica routing.
- [Sync](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/config/sync.html): Sync SQLAlchemy configuration module.
- [Types](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/config/types.html): Type aliases and constants used in the package config.
- [Repositories](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/repository.html): Documentation for Repositories.
- [Memory Repositories](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/repository_memory.html): Mock repositories evaluate basic column predicates against loaded model values. Boolean and null literals in comparisons retain SQL filtering semantics, including is_(True), is_not(False), and is_(None). SQL function...
- [Services](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/service.html): ResultConverter, OffsetPagination, schema helpers, and the service type variables are documented in Schema Conversion & Pagination.
- [Schema Conversion & Pagination](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/service_conversion.html): Result conversion, pagination containers, schema helpers, and type variables exported from advanced_alchemy.service.
- [Service Composition](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/service_composition.html): Documentation for Service Composition.
- [Filters](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/filters.html): See FilterSet for reusable class-based filter definitions and Cursor Pagination for keyset pagination.
- [Cursor Pagination](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/cursor_pagination.html): Keyset pagination filters, ordering keys, and the token codec hook. See Filtering and Pagination for usage and Schema Conversion & Pagination for the CursorPagination response container.
- [Bulk Operations](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/operations.html): Documentation for Bulk Operations.
- [Custom Types](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/types.html): Documentation for Custom Types.
- [Replica Routing](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/routing.html): Read/write replica session routing for SQLAlchemy engines and sessions. See RoutingConfig, ReplicaConfig, and RoutingStrategy for configuration.
- [Caching](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/cache.html): Dogpile L2 caching integration for SQLAlchemy repositories with commit-aware invalidation and per-process singleflight protection.
- [Extensions](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/extensions/index.html): First-party web framework integration packages for Litestar, FastAPI, Starlette, Flask, and Sanic.
- [Litestar](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/extensions/litestar/index.html): Litestar framework integration providing plugins, session lifecycle handlers, dependency injection providers, DTOs, server-side session backends, and CLI commands.
- [Plugins & Configuration](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/extensions/litestar/plugins.html): Documentation for Plugins & Configuration.
- [Data Transfer Objects](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/extensions/litestar/dto.html): Documentation for Data Transfer Objects.
- [Session Backends](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/extensions/litestar/session.html): This module provides SQLAlchemy-based session backends for Litestar’s server-side session middleware.
- [SQLAlchemy Store](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/extensions/litestar/store.html): This module provides a SQLAlchemy-backed implementation of Litestar’s Store protocol. Register a SQLAlchemyStore under the "sessions" store name to back Litestar’s server-side session middleware with your SQLAlchemy d...
- [CLI Commands](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/extensions/litestar/cli.html): Litestar CLI database group and plugin discovery utilities.
- [FastAPI](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/extensions/fastapi/index.html): FastAPI ASGI lifespan extension, dependency injection providers, and CLI helpers.
- [Starlette](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/extensions/starlette/index.html): Starlette ASGI extension, lazy request.state session middleware, and configuration classes.
- [Flask](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/extensions/flask/index.html): Flask app-context SQLAlchemy extension, JSON response service mixin, and CLI integration.
- [Sanic](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/extensions/sanic/index.html): Sanic and sanic-ext SQLAlchemy extension, request-context session middleware, and configuration classes.
- [Alembic](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/alembic/index.html): Programmatic Alembic migration commands, templates, and table export utilities.
- [Commands](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/alembic/commands.html): Documentation for Commands.
- [Utilities](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/alembic/utils.html): Documentation for Utilities.
- [Command-Line Interface](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/cli.html): Command-line interface and migration commands for Advanced Alchemy.
- [Exceptions](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/exceptions.html): Exception hierarchy and SQLAlchemy error translation utilities converting low-level driver errors such as sqlalchemy.exc.IntegrityError and sqlalchemy.exc.OperationalError into typed domain exceptions.
- [Fixtures](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/fixtures.html): Streaming fixture loaders, batch iterators, sharded writers, and format aliases.
- [Utilities](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/utils.html): See Fixtures for advanced_alchemy.utils.fixtures (open_fixture_sync, iter_fixture_sync, write_fixture_sync, and async counterparts).

## Project & Changelog

- [1.x Changelog](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/changelog.html): SQLAlchemySyncConfig, SQLAlchemyAsyncConfig, RoutingSyncSessionMaker, and RoutingAsyncSessionMaker now resolve sqlalchemy.create_engine and sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio.create_async_engine when creating engines rather than...
- [Contribution Guide](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/contribution-guide.html): 1. Run make install-uv to install uv if not already installed 1. Run make install to install all dependencies and pre-commit hooks
- [Advanced Alchemy Releases](https://advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/releases.html): This library follows the Semantic Versioning standard, using the <major>.<minor>.<patch> schema:
